responsibility: Implements the core executable Solaris target support shared across front ends. It manages pending Solaris pragma-derived attributes and later attaches them to declarations, emits .init/.fini section calls for init and fini attributes, handles Solaris-specific visibility assembly for Sun assemblers, emits Sun-as-compatible COMDAT group sections and deferred group-signature symbols, and adjusts options such as the default DWARF version for older Solaris linkers. This is the main backend/helper implementation file behind Solaris-specific hooks declared in sol2-protos.h.
same_name_distinction: Within the sol2 group, this is the implementation file for Solaris hooks and helpers—attribute insertion, .init/.fini emission, Sun-as visibility/COMDAT handling, and option overrides—whereas gcc/config/sol2.h declares the Solaris target policy via macros/specs and gcc/config/sol2.opt only enumerates Solaris options.
